The passages directly cover it. passage-000031 gives the 2024 vs 2023 net operating revenue bridge with a Foreign Currency Exchange Rate Fluctuations column: consolidated -5%, with segment-level impacts (EMEA -16%, Latin America -14%, Bottling Investments -28%). passage-000034 says FX fluctuations are expected to be unfavorable to full-year 2025 net operating revenues. passage-000066 states the total FX impact on net operating revenues including hedging was a 5% decrease in 2024 and 4% in 2023. Together these fully answer the subquery. Nothing requested is missing.
